confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate-confidence holistic estimates for a July resort window. Accommodation is less certain because of peak-season swings and an unstated rate basis (room-only, breakfast, or all-inclusive). Turkish lira inflation and depreciation add drift risk. Cocktail is set at about 2x draft beer and wine glass at about 1.2x beer because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. The FX value came from search summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages, not the live table, and the cached copies I saw conflicted on date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimated from general knowledge of Turkish Mediterranean resort pricing, benchmarked to Antalya-area resort towns and southern European resort norms. Turkey is mapped to the Middle East region as a transcontinental country. No live listings or booking pages were checked.
